page.title: Import Center
page.description: Preview and atomically import a versioned planning document generated by a person or an LLM.
steps.label: Import progress
select.title: Select a planning document
select.help: Choose a dm-tools-planning JSON document using schema version 2. The server validates the whole structure before proposing changes.
preview.title: Import preview
review.title: Review and confirm
review.blocked: This preview cannot be committed. Correct the source and create a new preview.
review.confirm: I reviewed the proposed changes and understand that this commit is atomic.
state.validating.title: Validating input
state.validating.body: The server is validating records, references, and conflicts. No data has changed.
state.committing.title: Committing import
state.committing.body: The approved preview is being committed atomically.
state.completed.title: Import completed
state.failed.title: Import failed
state.cancelled.title: Import cancelled
state.expired.title: Preview expired
state.revision-conflict.title: Campaign data changed
state.revision-conflict.body: The old preview is no longer valid. Create a new preview against the current planning data.
error.network: The response was interrupted. Check the job status before taking another action.
error.forbidden: The Import Center is available only to the effective DM.
error.providerMissing: The planning import provider is unavailable. The server addon may need a restart.
error.providerChanged: The provider changed after preview. Create a new preview.
error.revisionConflict: Planning data changed after preview. Nothing was imported.
error.expired: This import job expired. Nothing was imported.
error.cancelled: The import was cancelled. Nothing was imported.
error.timeout: Validation took too long. Nothing was imported.
error.busy: The Import Center is busy. Try again after another job finishes.
error.inputLimit: The selected file exceeds the provider limit.
error.generic: The import could not be completed. Nothing was imported.
diagnostic.documentType: The import document must be an object.
diagnostic.schema: The document schema version is unsupported.
diagnostic.recordsType: Each planning collection must be an array.
diagnostic.recordType: The planning record must be an object.
diagnostic.unknownField: The document contains an unknown field.
diagnostic.duplicateId: The input contains a duplicate identifier.
diagnostic.operation: A planning operation must be create or update.
diagnostic.localInvalid: A local planning record cannot be safely reconciled.
diagnostic.conflict: The requested operation conflicts with current campaign data.
diagnostic.planningField: A planning record contains an invalid field or value.
diagnostic.planningOwnership: The planning ownership tree contains a missing, invalid, or cyclic parent.
diagnostic.planningFlow: The story flow contains an invalid endpoint, option, or cycle.
diagnostic.planningReference: A planning reference or consequence anchor is invalid or missing.
